definitions.explanation: A pure and honest heart without any pretense or ulterior motives. Refers to genuine care, devotion, or goodwill.

examples.japanese: {真心|まごころ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧⟦{作|つく}りました→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made it with all my heart.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真心|まごころ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こもった⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感動|かんどう}した→感動する：21603_kandousuru⟧。
examples.english: I was moved by her heartfelt gift.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{客様|きゃくさま}→お客様：08780_okyakusama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{真心|まごころ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めた→込める：01945_komeru⟧⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提供|ていきょう}する→提供する：21736_teikyousuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{私|わたし}たち→私たち：28351_watashitachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使命|しめい}→使命：11445_shimei⟧です。
examples.english: Our mission is to provide heartfelt service to our customers.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly appears in the phrase {真心|まごころ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧ (with all one's heart, wholeheartedly). Frequently used in hospitality, gift-giving, and business contexts to express genuine care. It has a warm, somewhat elevated tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真心|まごころ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧: with all one's heart
- {真心|まごころ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こもった: heartfelt, sincere
- {真心|まごころ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尽|つ}くす→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧: to devote oneself sincerely

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{誠意|せいい}→誠意：19759_seii⟧: sincerity, good faith (more formal, used in apologies and negotiations)
- ⟦{真摯|しんし}→真摯：13670_shinshi⟧: earnest, sincere (na-adjective, emphasizes seriousness)
